questions.question: The apostle Paul felt deep sorrow for his fellow Israelites. What did he say he could wish for himself for their sake?

answers.text: To be cursed and cut off from Christ
To be locked in prison for life
To lose his calling as an apostle

questions.question: Paul quotes Scripture about Isaac and Rebecca's twin sons. Which twin does it say God loved?
Isaiah said the Israelites were as many as the sand of the sea. Who did he say would be saved?
Paul compares God to a potter working with one lump of clay. What does he say the potter has the right to make?

answers.text: A special vessel and a common one
